# VibeXForge — AI-Native Launch Platform
> Paste your AI project URL, get a Claude-scored review across 5 dimensions + watch it evolve Seed → Myth on real traction.

> Canonical name: **VibeXForge** (formerly VibeX). Aliases: "VibeX", "VibeX Forge".

## Full Content
Long-form description, live project list, live creator list, and
evolution-stage thresholds: https://www.vibexforge.com/llms-full.txt

## What VibeXForge Does
VibeXForge reviews your AI project's launch page using Claude Haiku 4.5. You paste a URL, Claude reads it like a first-time visitor, and returns structured, actionable feedback you can apply with one click. The gamification layer (evolution stages, pixel art, leaderboards) makes the feedback loop feel fun. Projects evolve Seed → Active → Growing → Breakout → Legend → Myth based on real plays, upvotes, and shares — not 24-hour upvote sprints.

## Key Pages
- /launch — Forge a project (paste URL, get AI review)
- /home — Dashboard with projects and daily leaderboard
- /hunt — Realtime rankings powered by Supabase
- /ideas — AI-scored idea validation before you build
- /creators — Builder profiles ranked by shipped work
- /project/{id} — Individual project detail with review history

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack, RSC streaming)
- Supabase (PostgreSQL, RLS, Realtime)
- Claude Haiku 4.5 for project reviews + Sonnet 4.6 for launch packages
- React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4 + Framer Motion
- Bilingual UI (English / Chinese)

## API
REST API at /api/* — 43 endpoints for project management, agent execution, and webhooks.
